people.imagined: Dawn on the beach by the third whaleboat, shouting an order across the surf though the man is two paces away, new iron on his shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: dawn on the shingle beach beside the third whaleboat; he has just bellowed an order at the crew across the surf though the nearest man is two paces away, then swings round to grin at the viewer with a bright new harpoon head on his shoulder. Face: a broad, red, windburnt face of forty-five with a wide square jaw and a big laughing mouth; one tooth gold-brown with tea; thick bushy black brows; small bright eyes; a bulbous nose with broken red veins; short black stubble with salt crystals in it. Hair: coarse black hair gathered in a topknot and bound with a silver-grey silk cord, stiff with salt, a few strands whipped across the forehead. Body: huge-chested and barrel-bodied with thick arms and a short neck, planted with legs apart in the shingle. Clothing: two crossed collars of sea-grey silk lined with soft seal fur, closed at the throat with pale ivory toggles; a black silk outer robe with wide sleeves pushed back to the elbow, the hems embroidered in silver thread with rolling waves; a broad sash of dark silk hung with an ivory pendant; silk hat-strings tied under his chin, the hat pushed back. Hands and objects: a freshly forged harpoon head, bright silver iron with a sharp barb, held shoulder-high in his right hand and throwing back a cold glint; the left hand grips the gunwale of the whaleboat. Power: a few motes of cold sea-blue light drift about the iron and his shoulders, faint, the qi of a middling cultivator. Background: a misty grey sea, a clinker-built whaleboat hauled up with a pale new-fitted plank, three crewmen blurred, pearly surf. Light: pale silver dawn from the upper left with a soft rim light along his shoulder. Expression: loud, boastful, greedy-bright; a man promising his crew a new hull.

people.imagined: At the seal inlet in summer; a grey seal has pushed its head up beside her and she rests a gloved hand on it, still.
people.subject: The moment: summer at the seal inlet; a grey seal has pushed its head up beside her and she rests a gloved hand on it, perfectly still, not to frighten it. Face: a quiet oval face of thirty-eight with wide-set patient dark eyes; a straight low nose; a soft full mouth, closed; sea-pale skin with faint freckles; level brows; salt-dry lips; a small wet dimple at one cheek. Hair: black, in a thick low braid over one shoulder, sea-damp, tied with a strip of kelp-brown silk and a small silver comb. Body: strong and sturdy with the broad shoulders of a diver, kneeling on one knee on a black rock ledge. Clothing: three layers of flowing sea-grey silk with crossed collars edged in pale ivory, the wide sleeves falling to the wrist and embroidered with silver waves; a gauze overrobe floating on the water-damp air; a silk sash with a jade pendant and a coil of fine line; and on both hands thick gloves of dark seal fur, big and obvious, worn though it is summer. Hands and objects: the right fur-gloved hand rests on the wet head of the seal; the left holds a short pole oar across her knees. Power: soft sea-blue motes rise from the water around her knees and gather faintly at her gloved hand. Background: clear green inlet water glowing in the dusk, a black rock shelf, drifting mist, a second seal head far off. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, a green glow reflected from the water onto her chin. Expression: peaceable and stubbornly patient, a person who has made a promise to a seal.

people.imagined: Sitting in the third whaleboat with a bailing scoop, which he picks up only when he sees his father looking.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in the bottom of the leaking third whaleboat with a bailing scoop in his lap; he sees the viewer, straightens quickly and begins to bail, grinning, because his father is watching. Face: a freckled, cheerful boy's face of seventeen; a notched left ear with a clean V cut out of the rim by the winter dive, big and obvious; messy straw-brown brows; bright easy eyes; a wide lazy grin; chapped red cheeks; a peeling nose. Hair: sandy hair in a short wet tangle caught up in a plain grey ribbon, salt-stiff. Body: tall, gangly and still growing, long wrists, sitting with knees apart; his father's broad back is a blurred dark shape at the stern, turned toward him. Clothing: a graceful sea-grey silk robe a little short in the sleeve, two crossed collars with ivory toggles, sleeves pushed up, a few simple silver waves stitched at the hem; a plain silk sash; hat-strings dangling. Hands and objects: a wooden bailing scoop in the right hand, dripping; seawater slopping round his ankles; the left hand holds the thwart; a dented tin cup floats in the bilge beside his foot; a short length of knotted twine is wound round his right wrist as a luck charm; a small bruise is yellowing on his left shin where the thwart caught him. Background: the inside of a leaky clinker boat, silver-grey water, pale ribs, a coil of harpoon line with an old iron head; gulls wheel in the mist above the beach and a small crab scuttles under the ribs. Light: cold bright moon-pale light from the upper left, a wet glitter on the planking and a soft rim along his hair. Expression: easygoing, a little guilty, delighted to be caught.

people.imagined: In the oil shed, steam rising, she skims a ladle from a jar when she thinks no one is looking, then freezes as the viewer enters.
people.subject: The moment: in the oil shed, steam rising; she has just skimmed a ladle from a jar when she thought no one was looking, and she freezes with the ladle halfway to her own jar as the viewer enters. Face: a pleasant round face of nineteen with a faint shine of oil on cheeks and nose; narrow clever eyes; a small mouth with a quick smile; a faint sallow cast from the steam; one dark curl stuck to her forehead. Hair: black, pinned in a tight bun under a pale linen cap tied with a silk ribbon. Body: small, quick and neat. Clothing: a clean grey silk robe with two crossed collars and an ivory toggle, the wide sleeves tied back with a silver cord so they stay out of the oil; a dark silk over-vest with an oil-dark hem only, embroidered at the border with small silver whales; a neat sash; soft slippers. Hands and objects: a long iron ladle with a drop of golden seal oil running off its lip, held above a squat brown jar; in the other hand the lid of the jar; steam curling round her wrists. Power: a faint thread of water-blue and metal-white light curls up with the steam, hardly more than a shimmer. Background: a rafter shed, rows of squat brown jars, a big black kettle over a fire with glowing steam, a small boy boiler in the corner. Light: warm firelight from the lower left, a soft glow in the steam, cool moonlit light from the door. Expression: dutiful on top, acquisitive and ambitious beneath, ready to smile her way out.

people.imagined: Dawn in the ruined hall's yard, sweeping. A goose has dropped down fluff into his hair and he has not noticed.
people.subject: The moment: dawn in the yard of a ruined monastery hall; he is sweeping, and a goose has dropped down fluff into his hair which he has not noticed. He stops and looks up gently at the viewer with a small bow of the head. Face: a thin gentle face of twenty-seven with a high forehead; mild brown eyes with long lashes; a small humble smile; sparse young beard; ears a little large; pale skin. Hair: dark, cropped short, with soft white goose down stuck in it, clearly visible. Body: slender, slightly stooped, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a plain light grey novice's robe of fine clean silk gauze, two crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back with a cord; a string of small wooden beads at the wrist; a pale sash with a single small jade bead; bare ankles above straw sandals. He is a novice of the palm hall and keeps to the simplest graceful dress. Hands and objects: both hands hold a twig broom; at his foot a small neat pile of reed leaves; a small notched stick in his belt on which he tallies repairs. Power: one or two faint sea-blue motes drift near his hands, hardly seen. Background: grey stone pillars of a ruined hall roofed in reeds, a few geese far behind, soft rising mist. Light: gentle misty dawn from the upper left, a pearly glow on his face and a thin rim light along the broom. Expression: a gentle, bowed look of quiet devotion, with the small smile of a man who asks nothing and will wait all morning.

people.imagined: On the beach at throw-off practice, she has just let a harpoon fly and stands with the throwing arm extended and a hard smile.
people.subject: The moment: on the beach at throw-off practice; she has just let a harpoon fly and stands with the throwing arm extended, turning her head to smile hard at the viewer. Face: a strong angular face of twenty-three with high cheekbones; narrow sea-grey eyes with a sharp glint; thin dark brows; a thin mouth in a cold smile; windburnt cheeks; a split in the lower lip. Hair: black, tied tight in a high ponytail with a silver clasp, silk hat-strings loose at the neck. Body: a lean wiry woman whose right arm is visibly a hand's width thicker than the left, the sleeve rolled up so the muscle reads plainly; the harpoon she threw stands quivering in a floating float-target some thirty paces out in the shallows, its line rippling back toward her wrist. Clothing: a black silk robe with a seal-fur collar and ivory toggles, two crossed collars, silver waves embroidered along the hem; the wide sleeve of her right arm is rolled so tight that the silk cuts a pale ring round the thick arm; a silk harness-sash across the chest hung with a small ivory pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand has just opened after the throw, fingers spread; in the left a coil of harpoon line and a second iron; a bone ring on her left thumb. Power: a streak of sea-blue light trails the line from her hand out to the target and fades. Background: a pale pearl sky, black shingle, surf; behind her on the shingle lie two spare irons in a row, the nearest with a chafed line she keeps looking at. Light: hard cold silver light from the upper left with a bright rim along her arm. Expression: a cold, sidelong smile and a hard bright eye, the look of a woman counting who stands between her and the bow seat.

people.imagined: In the boat shed, mending a harpoon line with her thumb; looks up shyly.
people.subject: The moment: in the boat shed, mending a harpoon line; she sits cross-legged and looks up shyly, showing her thumb. Face: a small patient, plain face of fifteen; round brown eyes; a small nose; a shy closed smile; freckles; a smudge of tar on the chin; on the plank beside her lie three finished eye-splices in a neat row and a fourth not yet tapered; the callus on her thumb is cracked yellow-brown, a thread of dried tar in its crease; her small hands are covered in tiny scars; behind her a taller boatmaster's shadow falls across the shed door, and she keeps one eye on the line he has marked with a chalk cross. Hair: brown, in two short plaits tied with silver-grey ribbon. Body: slight, young and very still, hunched a little over her work. Clothing: a simple grey silk robe with a small ivory toggle at the crossed collar, the sleeves tied back, a leather thimble-pad on the thumb; a plain sash with one small jade bead; soft slippers; clean and graceful though plain. Hands and objects: a thick tarred harpoon line across her knees, a marlin spike in her left hand, the right thumb held out, a callus on it as big as a coin and yellow as horn. Power: a single faint mote of pale green light settles on the line and dims. Background: a dim shed with hanging lines, oars, a cask of tar, soft haze; a ball of tarred twine rolls toward her foot. Light: soft lamp glow from the upper left, a gentle moonlit rim from the door. Expression: a shy, careful half-smile, eyes lifting only for a moment before dropping back to the line she is mending.

people.imagined: Standing waist-deep in freezing surf at dawn as if in a warm bath, the old white coat dark with spray, turning to see who has come.
people.subject: The moment: dawn at the frost coast; he stands waist-deep in freezing surf as if in a warm bath and turns his head slowly toward the viewer, utterly at ease, the old white robe dark with spray. Face: a thick, quiet, heavy-boned face of fifty-five with a seal hunter's squint; a broad nose; a wide calm mouth; short grey stubble; deep creases at the eyes; humble grey-blue eyes; skin pale and weathered, a faint white scar across the left cheekbone. Hair: iron-grey, gathered up under a small ivory crown, silk hat-strings tied under his chin. Body: a big, thick-set man with a deep chest, stooped slightly from the old wound. Clothing: the head's richest dress: several layers of flowing cream and white silk brocade with crossed collars, woven with silver whales and waves; over them a great mantle of pale whale-white fur and hide thrown across his shoulders, heavy and plain-cut, spray-dark at the hem; a wide silver-white sash hung with ivory and jade pendants; ivory collar toggles. Hands and objects: in the right hand a harpoon with a line of pale woven sinew coiled on the shaft; on the left hand a plain iron ring set with a chip of clear ice-like stone. Power: a slow ring of sea-blue and frost-white light spreads across the water around him, cold mist curling up from it, strong yet quiet. Background: a grey sea, pale dawn, ice floes drifting in the mist. Light: cold clear moonlike light from the upper left, a luminous rim along the mantle. Expression: peaceable, humble and quiet, the face of a man who once cut a line.

people.imagined: Dawn on the terrace facing the marsh; he guts a fish and tells his beads at once, no wasted motion.
people.subject: The moment: dawn on the terrace facing the marsh; he guts a fish and tells his beads at once, no wasted motion, and looks up at the viewer without surprise. Face: a bald, bony head; a long thin face with sharp cheekbones; hollow cheeks; thin bald brows; deep calm dark eyes; a long straight nose; thin forgiving mouth, almost smiling; brown spotted skin; the board before him is scarred with knife marks and wet with silver scales; his cuff is stained dark with brine and fish-oil and he has not wiped it. Hair: bald, shaved clean. Body: thin, wiry, sitting cross-legged and straight. Clothing: an elder's layered robe of grey silk and pale gauze with a crossed collar, the wide sleeves tied back, an outer coat of fine grey waxed silk buttoned to the throat, its borders embroidered with silver geese in flight and waves; a sash hung with a jade pendant; bare lean forearms; the faint far calls of geese carry from the marsh and he tilts his head toward them. Hands and objects: a string of 108 pale goose-bone beads running through his left fingers, large and clear; the right hand holds a small knife over a split silver fish on a wooden board; a tin kettle steams at his knee beside a plain pottery bowl of tea; a single goose-bone bead is slightly darker than the rest where his thumb stops. Power: a calm ring of pale blue and green motes drifts slowly about his shoulders and beads, strong and very quiet. Background: a grey marsh of reeds far away, a flock of geese lifting low, black rock; his feet are bare on cold black rock, toes gnarled. Light: pale gold dawn from the upper left with a soft rim light. Expression: an unhurried stillness, a faint near-smile and deep calm eyes, a face that has long since forgiven the world.

people.imagined: Rowing at dawn with her seals following; she shades her eyes at the white north.
people.subject: The moment: dawn on the sea; standing in the stern of the sixth boat, she shades her eyes with one hand and looks to the white north, then to the viewer; a small dark seal watches over the gunwale. Face: a long-jawed, sea-browned face of forty; bright restless eyes the grey of cold water; thin high brows; a straight nose; a firm quick mouth; deep tan with salt crystals at the temples; her forearms are crossed with fine pale scratches from sea-urchin spines; on her left wrist a woven band of sealskin; a second, smaller seal swims beside the hull, only its whiskered nose out of the water. Hair: a thick mane of salt-white hair, loose and wet to the waist, white since twenty, striking against her dark skin, with a single ivory hairpin. Body: long-armed, long-legged, lean and muscular. Clothing: a true disciple's dress of a black silk sleeveless over-robe with silver-embroidered waves and whales at the border, worn over a layered sea-grey silk shirt with two crossed collars and ivory toggles; silk hat-strings loose; a wide sash hung with an ivory pendant; long gauze ribbons stirring in the sea wind. Hands and objects: one long arm shading her brow; at her side a small dark seal looks over the gunwale; a coil of wet rope lies at her feet beside a small tin of fish. Power: sea-blue light ripples under the hull and rises as thin glowing motes around her, brighter than a novice's. Background: grey open sea in drifting mist, a distant white shelf of ice glowing faintly; far behind her the other five boats are small dark marks on the grey. Light: cold moonlit morning from the upper left, a silver rim along her white hair. Expression: bold and restless eyes, a quick firm mouth with a hint of a smirk, a woman eager to be gone over the water.

people.imagined: On the quay, hefting a new iron to show a boat's crew; the scar across his face pulls tight as he grins.
people.subject: The moment: on the quay he holds a new bright iron harpoon head up to the light to show a boat's crew, turning to the viewer with a wide persuasive grin; the scar pulls tight. Face: a huge square face of forty-two; a thick white harpoon scar running from the left cheek past the jaw to the collarbone, big and plain, with a thin ridge of stitched flesh along its length; a flat broken nose; heavy brows; shrewd dark eyes; a full-lipped grin; dark stubble; a leather thong with a walrus tooth hangs on the bare skin of his neck under the collar. Hair: black, cropped, bound with a silver-grey silk band round the brow. Body: very tall, massive shoulders and arms. Clothing: an inner-hall captain's dress of black and sea-grey silk in several layers, two crossed collars lined with thick seal fur, ivory toggles, silver waves and whales embroidered along the borders; the wide sleeves are cut a little short to show his thick wrists; a broad silk sash with an ivory pendant. Hands and objects: a freshly forged, gleaming iron harpoon head in his right hand held high near his face; a coil of new line over his left arm; on the quay beside him three iron heads lie on a sealskin cloth, each cut with the same small notch; behind him a boat-crew of four stands in a row, one man reaching to touch the barb. Power: cold sea-blue light gathers along the iron's edge and a few motes drift about his shoulders. Background: a quay with six boats in pale mist, a leafless frozen shore. Light: cold bright silver light from the upper left, the gleam of new iron and a rim of light along his scar. Expression: a wide, persuasive grin and bright shrewd eyes, a man already tallying what the crew will pay him for that iron.

people.imagined: At the pearl market in Mộc Lan Thành, she turns her head to show one seed pearl in her left ear and counts a coin.
people.subject: The moment: at the pearl market of a harbour town, she turns her head to show her left ear with its single seed pearl and looks at the viewer sideways, assessing. Face: a pale smooth oval face of thirty-eight; dark, calm, quick eyes; thin arched brows; a small straight nose; closed, patient mouth; a single small round milky seed pearl in her left ear lobe, plain and visible, slightly yellower than the others in the tray; a hint of sea-salt on her lips. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot held with a carved bone pin and a short pearl-tipped silver pin. Body: slight, composed and upright, her head tilted so the market light catches the pearl. Clothing: three layers of fine silk, a dark sea-grey inner robe with a crossed collar and ivory toggles, a deep black over-robe with silver waves embroidered at the sleeve borders, and a pale sea-green gauze sash, wide sleeves falling in soft folds; fitted cuffs; a thin silver chain holds a small scale-weight and a jade pendant at her sash. Hands and objects: a small flat bead tray lined with black sealskin, of pale ice-pearls, cradled in her left palm; her right fingers, long and a little wrinkled from the water, nails clipped square, pick one up between thumb and finger. Power: a soft sea-blue glimmer pools on the pearls and echoes faintly in her eyes. Background: a market awning, indistinct buyers, drifting sea-mist; behind her at the next stall a fishwife is blurred in mid-haggle. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, a gentle gleam off the pearls. Expression: a steady, closed-mouthed look from the corner of her eye, weighing the price of every pearl before she names it.

people.imagined: In the boat shed splicing a line by lamp; he holds up his scarred, black-nailed hand.
people.subject: The moment: in the boat shed he holds up his splinter-scarred forearm and black-nailed hand beside a half-spliced line, glancing at the viewer; he was in the boat in 1080 and has told the story his own way for years. Face: a long grey-skinned face of fifty-five with a heavy jaw; deep vertical lines; stubborn small blue eyes; a flat white moustache; scowling brows; his forearm has pale puckered splinter scars in lines like stitches; a narrow burn scar rings the wrist where a hawser once slipped. Hair: thin grey hair tied back with a tarred cord and a plain silver pin; the half-spliced line is a thick tarred rope with three strands opened like a flower. Body: tall, bony, bent at the shoulders; he sits on an upturned barrel with one knee up. Clothing: a steward's robe of clean grey silk, soft at the elbows, two crossed collars with ivory toggles, sleeves rolled, the borders embroidered with silver waves; a dark silk work-apron over it, kept tidy; a plain sash with an ivory pendant; felt slippers. Hands and objects: the forearm with a hundred fine pale splinter scars, the nails tar-black, in the foreground; a fid and a half-finished eye-splice in the other hand; behind him in the shed stand two boats, one gleaming with fresh pitch and one with a dark leak-stain along the keel, and he has put the fresh pitch brush in the clean boat's bucket. Power: a faint haze of cold blue qi hangs about his scarred hand. Background: a shed of ribs, hanging oars, a tar pot, one lamp, soft haze. Light: lamplight from the upper left, with a thin cold rim light from the doorway. Expression: a scowl under heavy brows, jaw set, the look of an old man who will not change the story he tells even if shown the truth.

people.imagined: On the ice edge, kneeling by a seal, pulling off a boot to show a missing toe to the boys.
people.subject: The moment: at the ice edge, sitting on a floe, he has pulled off one boot to show a missing-toed foot to new crew, and smirks at the viewer. Face: a narrow, cold young face of twenty-one; pale cruel eyes; a thin smile held too long; thin brows; chapped lips; a frost-pink nose; a dead grey seal lies on the floe behind him with its flipper still twitching, a thin dark line on the white ice. Hair: dark, cut short under a silver band, silk hat-strings tied tight. Body: wiry and quick, crouched with the knees up. Clothing: a black silk robe with a seal-fur collar, two crossed collars and ivory toggles, silver waves along the hem, wide sleeves tied back; silk trousers; one boot beside him on the ice; beside him two younger boys in grey silk crouch, one looking away; his harpoon's shaft is carved with notch-marks, one for each kill, and his fingers are tapping them. Hands and objects: the bare foot held up, two outer toes gone, shown plainly with a smooth pink stump pattern at the outer edge; a harpoon laid across his knees. Power: faint sea-blue motes curl off his bare foot like steam in the cold. Background: white ice, grey water, a wounded seal blurred on the floe, drifting mist. Light: hard cold moonlight from the upper left, a bluish rim light along his cheek. Expression: a thin smile held a beat too long and pale eyes that enjoy the new crew's discomfort, every inch his captain's man.

people.imagined: Early in the week she has just pinned a fresh gull feather into her braid and stands holding the chest-lid open.
people.subject: The moment: in her hut, she pins a fresh white gull feather into her braid and looks over her shoulder at the viewer while holding the lid of a small chest half open. Face: a narrow, hard face of twenty-four; thin vengeful eyes the colour of slate; thin brows; a tight mouth; pale complexion. Hair: black, in a long braid over her shoulder with a single fresh white gull feather woven in, big and plain; the new feather is bright against older, greyed ones tied lower in the braid, one for each week, and a silver ribbon winds through it. Body: small, rigid and upright; beside the chest a dried gull's wing is pinned to the wall; her thin shoulders are lifted high with tension. Clothing: a plain but graceful grey silk robe with two crossed collars, ivory toggles and a white-grey gauze scarf, silver waves at the cuffs; a carved bone toggle hangs at her collar; soft felt slippers. Hands and objects: one hand lifts the braid with the feather; behind her a small wooden chest lid half open with the corner of a white cloth showing, painted with a grey gull in flight (no text); her fingers are chapped; a bowl of cold fish broth sits untouched on the floor. Power: a thin pale-blue shimmer clings to the feather and the open chest. Background: a dim hut wall with fishing floats and a hung net, soft haze. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left through a gap in the wall, a cold rim along her braid. Expression: a tight, shuttered mouth and slate eyes that give nothing away, every feather placed with grim care.

people.imagined: Yawning on the boat shed bench over a net, and the yawn never finishes.
people.subject: The moment: on the bench in the boat shed, half-yawning over a knotted net on his knees, one hand over his mouth, eyes still on the viewer. Face: a round, sleepy face of seventeen; heavy eyelids; round cheeks; crumbs in a short fuzz of moustache; wide mouth mid-yawn. Hair: brown, short and sticking up, with one grey silk ribbon tied loosely in it. Body: soft, stocky, slouched; the net on his lap is enormous, a coarse grey cord mesh spilling over his knees and on to the shed floor in coils, with a fresh row of knots started at one edge; a pearl shell sits on a shelf behind him, a gift he stares at. Clothing: a clean grey silk robe with two crossed collars and ivory toggles, a sea-grey over-vest with a few silver waves at the hem; baggy silk trousers; felt slippers; a plain sash with a small jade bead. Hands and objects: net-twine calluses across his palm, held up; a huge knotted net heaped across his lap; a bone netting needle; beside him on the bench a wooden pail of yellow tallow, a tin cup of cold tea and half a hard biscuit; his thumbs are blue-black with twine dye and the callus ridges are shiny. Power: a faint sleepy mote of green light drifts from the net and fades. Background: a shed with nets hanging, floats, a soft haze, the pearl shell glimmering. Light: lazy lamp glow from the upper left, a soft moonlit rim from the door. Expression: heavy lids and a cheerful, rounded face caught in a yawn, a boy at ease with everyone who walks into the shed.

people.imagined: In a boat with the spray coming up, he holds his pale hands out of the water and flinches at a crack.
people.subject: The moment: in a rocking boat, spray coming up; he flinches with eyes half shut at a harpoon crack and keeps his pale hands raised out of the spray. Face: a thin pale face of nineteen; large worried eyes; fine brows lifted; a small mouth; a drop of spray on his nose; his uncle's big bearded shadow looms at the edge of the frame holding an iron up; he has bitten his lower lip until it is red. Hair: soft brown, damp and flat, tied with a plain grey ribbon. Body: narrow, slight and hunched. Clothing: a clean dark silk robe with two crossed collars and an ivory toggle, a few silver waves at the border, sleeves down to the knuckles; silk trousers; on his sash a small silk pouch of dried herbs and a roll of bandage cloth are tucked, his one comfort. Hands and objects: both pale unmarked hands held up near his chest, clearly visible, scrubbed clean and never touched an oar; a small herb pouch at his belt. Power: faint cool motes of sea-blue light beaded in the spray around his hands, hardly there. Background: grey water in drifting mist, the side of a boat, a distant harpoon splash; the boat's gunwale is slick with salt rime; a small wave slaps the hull behind him and a plume of cold spray hangs in the air, beaded on his fringe. Light: cold silver-grey light from the upper left, a soft glow in the spray. Expression: afraid, humble, trying not to show it.

people.imagined: In the surf with a little fish in her hand for a tame seal; the seal's whiskers just at her fingers.
people.subject: The moment: in the surf, crouched knee-deep, she holds out a small silver fish to a seal whose head is just in the picture, laughing at the viewer. Face: a freckled open face of twenty-nine, freckles in dense dots across her nose like seal whiskers; bright wide-set brown eyes; a wide trusting grin; wet lashes; the seal's whiskers just brush her wrist and she tries not to laugh and scare it. Hair: black, in a wet plait with a silver clip, a thread of kelp caught. Body: sturdy and sun-brown, crouched; her knees are red-raw from the cold surf and her toes are curled in the sand; a little tin whistle on a cord at her neck calls the seals. Clothing: a grey silk robe with two crossed collars and ivory toggles, the wide sleeves pushed up, a dark sea-grey over-vest with silver waves at the border; rolled silk trousers; a sash hung with a jade pendant; at her belt a net bag of small silver fish, dripping. Hands and objects: a small silver fish held out in the right hand; the dark wet head of a seal at the edge of the frame. Power: ripples of sea-blue light spread softly around her knees and the seal's nose. Background: silver surf in drifting mist, a pale sky; two other seals drift farther out, grey backs rolling; a line of spray-wet footprints leads from the dry shingle behind her. Light: bright cold moonlit morning from the upper left, a sparkling rim light on the water. Expression: a wide open grin and shining eyes, pure delight, her whole face softening for the seal.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder holding the line he wove from the first whale's sinew.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened: the founder in the bow of a whaleboat holds up a long pale woven line of sinew, looking at the viewer with a warm smile. Face: a broad weathered face of fifty with a generous grin; crinkled eyes; a short beard; heavy brows; ruddy skin; the painting's silk shows a faded brown stain along its lower edge and a thin vertical fold-crease across his chest. Hair: black with grey, bound up in a topknot with an ivory hairpin, silk hat-strings under the chin. Body: tall, strong and easy; his hat hangs by its strings down his back, and a gull sits on the bow post, painted in thin grey strokes. Clothing: the founder's rich robes in faded tones: layered cream, grey and black silk with crossed collars lined in seal fur, ivory toggles, a mantle of pale fur, silver waves and whales embroidered along every border, a bone-handled flensing knife hung at a wide sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold a pale braided sinew line stretched taut before his chest, glowing faintly cream against the dull silk. Power: a faint, faded ring of pale blue light about his shoulders, as if remembered. Background: a clear inlet in drifting mist, a black rock terrace; behind him three whaleboats ride low, their crews small figures with oars raised. Light: faded soft light, yellowed, with a dim luminous rim. Expression: a warm, open grin with crinkled eyes, the look of a man who gives away his catch and fears nothing at sea.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the last abbot of the marsh abbey carrying his disciples to the terrace.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened: an old monk stands with both hands joined at his chest, looking at the viewer kindly, after leading his disciples out of the marsh abbey. Face: a long, gentle, deeply lined face of seventy; calm sunken eyes; a bald head; thin white brows; a faint smile; the portrait's silk is darkened at the corners as if by smoke and split at one edge, mended with a thread of brown. Hair: bald. Body: tall, thin and stooped. Clothing: an elder's grey silk monk's robe in several layers, crossed collar, wide sleeves hanging long over the cuffs, the borders embroidered with faded silver geese and waves; a long string of goose-bone beads looped round his neck, over a fine grey oilskin coat. Hands and objects: the hands joined, a bead string between them; the beads are 108 small pale discs strung on a faded cord, one bead slightly larger at the knot. Power: a faint pale glow rests about his joined hands and the beads, as if remembered. Background: soft grey reeds and a few geese, faded; a ring of reed-thatched roofs of the marsh abbey can just be seen, and above it a line of pale geese flies low across a yellowed sky. Light: dim, yellowed, with a soft luminous rim. Expression: a faint, kind smile on a tired face, eyes soft with a lifetime of caring for others.
